title: Check reward options in pack preparation without Torch
summary: locomotion.prepare checked reward options by importing the selected task module, which imports Torch, so the SPARK preparation command failed on a host without Torch with ModuleNotFoundError. locomotion.reward_options now reads the task's reward configuration from its source with the standard library: the annotated fields of the dataclass and its bases, and the word choices that validate declares. Preparation refuses an unknown or repeated key, a value that does not convert to its field's type and a word outside its choices; the trainer still applies the task's reward_config before launch.
next: Prepare yaw-gated packs on a host without Torch with the SPARK command.
reason: The change moves a preparation check to the standard library; it changes no reward, pack or result.
